# CORRECTION of my 00:37 column "bind elab gives the rest": WITHDRAWN. The bind elab does not apply per-type defines at all. It reads only the die-wide asbuilt defines (15 names: DSFD_PQ_STATIC_X2, S81CTRL_*, OT_COLL_NATIVE32*, OT_S81ENG_*, OT_S81SL_KV_TRANSPORT, OT_SVC_ALLQ, SU_SMU_T, OT_ATTN_HCORE, OT_S81C_HCORE_*, S81_HOSTB_LAND_OBS). None of the mixed defines is in it. So the risk runs the other way: a type that LISTS a define may get it OFF in the bound RTL (class BIND_IGNORED: read by a dissolved body file) unless the per-type variant pass realizes it; a define read only by leaf files the bind keeps as interfaces is class KIT (kit honours it, bind blind by design, no receipt variant needed). That is why a receipt can show variants only for the defines the variant pass handled.
